t: A riddle he put to them
a: إِنَّ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرَةً لاَ يَسْقُطُ وَرَقُهَا، وَإِنَّهَا مَثَلُ الْمُسْلِمِ، فَحَدِّثُونِي مَا هِيَ
p: Inna mina-sh-shajari shajaratan lā yasquṭu waraquhā, wa innahā mathalu-l-muslim, fa-ḥaddithūnī mā hiya
m: Among the trees there is a tree whose leaves do not fall. It is like the Muslim. Tell me what it is.
